study type: quality improvement project with a retrospective pre-intervention phase and a prospective intervention and post-intervention phase
exposure: Daily audit and feedback on SSC and antibiotic use
Educational intervention on WHO Surgical Safety Checklist (SSC) and pre-operative antibiotic use
cohort: 678 women undergoing cesarean delivery at Mbarara Regional Referral Hospital maternity ward in Uganda
finding: The educational intervention with daily audit and feedback significantly increased adherence to WHO SSC and pre-operative antibiotic administration, although the rates waned in the post-intervention phase.
